instruction: I need bibtex citations for my machine learning paper. The reference list is in the opened docx file. Please export DBLP bibtex entries for the last 2 papers (BERT and GPT-3/Language Models are Few-Shot Learners) to 'references.bib'. Use published versions, not arxiv. Add blank lines between entries for readability.

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting bibtex for the last 2 papers (BERT and GPT-3). Evaluator performs comprehensive validation: (1) checks for exactly 2 bibtex entries, (2) verifies specific papers using improved keywords (BERT with 'pre-training'/'bidirectional', GPT-3 with 'few-shot learners'), (3) ensures no arxiv references (published versions only), (4) checks for blank lines between entries, (5) verifies entries are from DBLP source.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Weighted scoring: Entry count (20%), Papers found (35%), No arxiv (20%), Blank lines (10%), DBLP source (15%)

llm_judge_reasons: Complete instruction coverage: Evaluator validates all requirements - entry count (exactly 2), specific papers with improved keywords, no arxiv references, blank line formatting, and DBLP source verification
Improved keyword matching: Uses specific identifiers (BERT with 'pre-training'/'bidirectional', GPT-3 with 'few-shot learners') to correctly identify the intended papers

Comprehensive validation logic: Checks arxiv patterns (arxiv.org URLs, eprint fields), blank line separation (regex pattern \}\s*\n\s*\n\s*@), and DBLP source indicators (dblp.org URLs, bibsource fields)
Appropriate weighted scoring: Entry count 20%, Papers found 35%, No arxiv 20%, Blank lines 10%, DBLP source 15% - reflects importance of each requirement
Getter extracts correct state: Returns titles, raw_content, entries, and entry_count - all needed for comprehensive metric validation

Minor issue: Keyword-based paper identification could still match wrong papers in edge cases (e.g., a survey paper about BERT pre-training methods). Exact title matching would be more robust but might be too strict for bibtex title variations
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding exact title substring matching as an alternative to keyword matching for more precise paper identification (e.g., check for 'BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers' or 'Language Models are Few-Shot Learners')
Consider verifying that the two entries found are distinct papers (not duplicates of the same paper)
validation.fix_summary: Enhanced getter to return comprehensive dict with titles, raw_content, entries, and entry_count. Updated metric to validate all requirements: entry count (exactly 2), specific paper identification (improved keywords), no arxiv references, blank line formatting, and DBLP source verification. Implemented weighted scoring across all validation aspects.
